text: Could I get a table for two?
hint_ja: 2人席をお願いできますか
example: Hi, could I get a table for two? By the window if possible.

text: What do you recommend?
hint_ja: おすすめは何ですか
example: It's my first time here. What do you recommend?

text: Can I get this to go?
hint_ja: これは持ち帰りにできますか
example: Can I get this to go? I'm running a bit late.

text: Could we get the check, please?
hint_ja: お会計をお願いできますか
example: Could we get the check, please? We're all done.

text: Is this seat taken?
hint_ja: この席は空いていますか
example: Excuse me, is this seat taken? Mind if I sit here?

text: Which platform is the train to the airport?
hint_ja: 空港行きの電車はどのホームですか
example: Sorry, which platform is the train to the airport? Two or three?

text: How long does it take to get there?
hint_ja: そこまでどれくらいかかりますか
example: How long does it take to get there by bus?

text: Do you have this in a bigger size?
hint_ja: これの大きいサイズはありますか
example: Do you have this in a bigger size? A large, maybe.

text: I'm just looking, thanks.
hint_ja: 見ているだけです、ありがとう
example: I'm just looking, thanks. I'll let you know if I need anything.

text: Can I pay by card?
hint_ja: カードで払えますか
example: Can I pay by card, or is it cash only?

text: I have a reservation under Sato.
hint_ja: 佐藤の名前で予約しています
example: Good evening. I have a reservation under Sato, for two nights.

text: What time is checkout?
hint_ja: チェックアウトは何時ですか
example: What time is checkout? Can I leave my bag here after that?

text: I think I'm lost.
hint_ja: 道に迷ったみたいです
example: I think I'm lost. Is the museum this way?

text: Is it within walking distance?
hint_ja: 歩いて行ける距離ですか
example: Is it within walking distance, or should I take the subway?

text: I left my bag on the train.
hint_ja: 電車にかばんを忘れました
example: I left my bag on the train. Who should I talk to?

text: Could you call me a taxi?
hint_ja: タクシーを呼んでもらえますか
example: Could you call me a taxi? My flight is at nine.

text: How's it going?
hint_ja: 調子はどう?
example: Hey! How's it going? Long time no see.

text: What have you been up to?
hint_ja: 最近どうしてた?
example: What have you been up to? Still working at the cafe?

text: Are you free this weekend?
hint_ja: 今週末は空いてる?
example: Are you free this weekend? There's a new ramen place I want to try.

text: Let's grab a coffee sometime.
hint_ja: いつかコーヒーでも行こう
example: Let's grab a coffee sometime. I want to hear about your trip.

text: I'm really into it these days.
hint_ja: 最近それにすごくハマってる
example: Korean dramas? Yeah, I'm really into it these days.

text: That sounds fun.
hint_ja: 楽しそう
example: A day trip to the beach? That sounds fun. Count me in.

text: I'm kind of tired today.
hint_ja: 今日はちょっと疲れてる
example: I'm kind of tired today. Can we make it an early night?

text: No worries, take your time.
hint_ja: 大丈夫、ゆっくりでいいよ
example: No worries, take your time. I'll wait by the entrance.

text: I totally get that.
hint_ja: それ、すごく分かる
example: I totally get that. Mondays are rough for me too.

text: Let me know when you get there.
hint_ja: 着いたら教えて
example: Let me know when you get there, and I'll come find you.

text: It was great seeing you.
hint_ja: 会えてよかった
example: It was great seeing you. Let's do this again soon.

text: Say hi to your family for me.
hint_ja: ご家族によろしく
example: Say hi to your family for me. Especially your mom.

text: Have you seen the latest episode?
hint_ja: 最新話、見た?
example: Have you seen the latest episode? No spoilers, I promise.

text: I binge-watched the whole season.
hint_ja: シーズン全部を一気見した
example: I binge-watched the whole season in two days. No regrets.

text: The ending totally got me.
hint_ja: 最後、完全にやられた
example: The ending totally got me. I didn't see it coming at all.

text: This song is stuck in my head.
hint_ja: この曲が頭から離れない
example: This song is stuck in my head. I've been humming it all day.

text: I watched it with subtitles.
hint_ja: 字幕付きで見た
example: I watched it with subtitles first, then without.

text: The main character is so relatable.
hint_ja: 主人公がすごく共感できる
example: The main character is so relatable. She overthinks everything, like me.

text: It's kind of slow at first, but it gets better.
hint_ja: 最初はちょっと遅いけど、だんだん良くなる
example: It's kind of slow at first, but it gets better after episode three.

text: Who's your favorite member?
hint_ja: 推しは誰?
example: Who's your favorite member? Mine changes every week.

text: I saw them live last year.
hint_ja: 去年ライブで見た
example: I saw them live last year. The energy was unreal.

text: The lyrics hit different in English.
hint_ja: 歌詞が英語だと響き方が違う
example: The lyrics hit different in English. It feels more direct.

text: I'm still catching up on it.
hint_ja: まだ追いかけている途中
example: I'm still catching up on it, so don't tell me what happens.

text: You have to check it out.
hint_ja: 絶対見てみて
example: You have to check it out. It's only six episodes.
